UI_Storm_LowRam_Title: Your game is low on memory
UI_Storm_LowRam_Intro: Project Zomboid is running with only %1 GB of memory. On a multiplayer server that causes lag, stutter, and freezes. The free Storm Launcher gives the game more memory for you, so there is no -Xmx launch option to set.
UI_Storm_LowRam_BenefitsTitle: What you get with the Storm Launcher
UI_Storm_LowRam_Benefit1: More memory. The launcher sizes the game's memory to fit your PC.
UI_Storm_LowRam_Benefit2: FPS boost. Storm patches slow spots in the game loop, so the game runs smoother.
UI_Storm_LowRam_Benefit3: Vanilla crash and error fixes. Known crashes, freezes, and desyncs in the base game are patched.
UI_Storm_LowRam_Benefit4: Faster server joining. The world download runs over a dedicated connection, and known join stalls are fixed.
UI_Storm_LowRam_Benefit5: Fixes mod download errors with Steam. Workshop mods are checked and updated before the game starts.
UI_Storm_LowRam_Step1: In Steam, right-click Project Zomboid, open Properties, and paste the line for your system into Launch Options. Replace any -Xmx line that is already there. The Copy buttons below put the line on your clipboard.
UI_Storm_LowRam_Step2: Start Project Zomboid from Steam. The Storm Launcher opens. Pick this server and press Join Server.
UI_Storm_LowRam_ManagedIntro: Project Zomboid is running with only %1 GB of memory. On a multiplayer server that causes lag, stutter, and freezes. You can raise it in the Storm Launcher.
UI_Storm_LowRam_ManagedStep1: Close the game and start Project Zomboid from Steam, so the Storm Launcher opens.
UI_Storm_LowRam_ManagedStep2: Open Settings and find Game memory. Untick Automatic and pick a larger size.
UI_Storm_LowRam_ManagedNote: Automatic keeps the game's default memory on PCs with little RAM to spare, because the game also needs room outside that memory for graphics and sound. If the game fails to start after the change, tick Automatic again.
UI_Storm_ServerNoStorm_Title: Storm is not running on this server
UI_Storm_ServerNoStorm_Intro: This server has the Storm mod enabled, but it was started without the Storm bootstrap agent. Only the mod's Lua loaded, so Storm's Java fixes and performance patches are off.
UI_Storm_ServerNoStorm_Fix: Server owner, add these two Java arguments to the server start script and restart the server. The server console prints the same lines at startup.
UI_Storm_ServerNoStorm_Hosted: On a managed host, add them to the JVM arguments (vmArgs in ProjectZomboid64.json) after the server has downloaded the mod once.
